goal: measure how close the ChatGPT hosted machine is to running a Windows VM internally

interpretation.hardware_virtualization: host CPU supports it but the guest is not given /dev/kvm
interpretation.full_emulation: technically still possible if a user-space emulator such as QEMU plus firmware and image can be injected into the machine
interpretation.normal_package_install_from_internet: not available through the container network
interpretation.next_best_route: inject emulator/packages/image through an allowed file bridge, then attempt software-only x86_64 emulation
